name: context-diet
description: Trims what the model reads at session start: unused skills in the skill listing and, opt-in, the superpowers gatekeeper block.

dropSkills.title: Skills hidden from the model
dropSkills.description: Comma-separated skill names left out of the skill listing (you can still type them as /commands).

stripGatekeeper.title: Strip the superpowers gatekeeper
stripGatekeeper.description: Removes the <EXTREMELY_IMPORTANT> using-superpowers block injected at SessionStart; the skills stay.
